items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, go-live, notification expansion, monetization change, or rights outreach; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that adds no new data collection, permissions, credentials, dependencies, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, public display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; current public terms point against the proposed commercial/public data use. The four legal launch tasks remain open, with 0/4 closed. Fleet compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics is available for measured sites but does not establish consent or legal clearance. Amazon data covers 2026-09-21 only; $4.92 is aggregate and unattributed, so site revenue, ROI, margin, and causal lift remain unknown. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, leave outreach unsent, preserve existing gates, and do not approve any go-live proposal.

Candidate-plan decision: reject both new product proposals this cycle. They add queue and validation work while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, 39 improvements await measurement, 21 requests failed, and only 6 outcomes are proven. Preserve existing canonical work only. No new telemetry request is warranted; available analytics and revenue evidence must be used with their stated attribution limits.

Next evidence action for the active SearchWoot workstream: attach one dated read-only bundle to the existing checklist containing the repository/config data-flow and retention table, deployed consent/withdrawal capture, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, log-field and access inventory, Cloudflare/vendor terms or DPA status, and incident/data-subject request procedures. Do not change production, enable tracking, send outreach, or close tasks without evidence.
